entries.title: Ninja V15 — narrow walk grounding repair
entries.changes: Author dense measurements against the unchanged world Z=0.012 m floor: V13 penetrates in 742/993 walk samples (worst 2.963029 mm); V15 source and actual Blender-imported primary/LOD1/LOD2 each have 0/993 penetrating samples. Minimum clearances are 0.745924 / 0.746586 / 0.746586 / 0.683716 mm respectively. Four before/after comparison views show the small sole-clearance correction. Independent Blender/Three.js/Godot checks now complete: all three visual LODs have 1,089 samples each with zero penetration. Godot default 30 fps support gaps span 0.59265–3.33609 mm; explicit 192 fps spans 0.68326–0.75043 mm. A 10 mm downward negative fixture rejects all 993 walk samples per LOD in Three.js/Godot.
entries.remaining: Godot uses imported Skeleton/Skin CPU evaluation, not rendering. Importer bake-rate differences and preserved provisional harness failures limit the claim; no GPU or continuous-time acceptance. This V13-derived animation repair excludes V14 material changes. Contact IK, foot sliding, terrain response and walk/idle/cast transitions remain unvalidated; existing likeness/equipment defects remain. Sampled nonpenetration is not continuous proof or gameplay acceptance.

entries.title: Daybreak r05 — exported socket repair
entries.changes: Three anchor defects repaired without visual refinement: hidden LOD duplicates, damaged lower-LOD canonical identities and 20 misplaced floor-adapter anchors. Frozen author evidence records 22 changed / 169 unchanged inherited payloads, seven Blender sources and nine GLBs repaired. All 56 visual-module/fixture socket audits pass; visible geometry, material, image and animation fingerprints are unchanged. Three CPU rerenders have zero changed RGB pixels. Independent checks verify the full 290-payload freeze, nine actual GLB imports and seven saved-source opens, zero Khronos errors/warnings, all 56 exported socket audits, and 391 actual Three.js world positions (maximum error 0.39321 micrometers). Duplicate and 15 mm displacement negatives reject; all five saved fixture anchors match and four adapter mesh bounds agree within 0.26227 micrometers.
entries.remaining: Independent project gate: 16 structural passes, one explicitly incomplete baffle, zero hard errors; this is not 17 accepted modules. The native module consumer passes 691 checks but does not alone certify fixture assemblies. This remains 17 module designs, not a new art family: baffle collision, art fidelity, physics/controller traversal, Unreal, GPU and performance acceptance remain open.

views.label: Repaired civic assembly — same visual pixels as r04

entries.title: Fault V13 — local facet improvement only
entries.changes: Angular crystal faces and articulated stone relief improve over flatter V12. This local change does not establish exact matching quality.
entries.remaining: The long connected central channel, tiled stone banks, near-parallel substrate rails, bulky cuff, prism pommel and regular wrap remain unlike the source.

entries.title: Ninja V14 — near-neutral material diagnostic
entries.changes: Material baking produces subtle finish changes; independent pixels show no clear source-likeness gain over V13. This is not an overall art improvement. Baseline exports are historical reproduction inputs, not additional delivered designs.
entries.remaining: Broad repeated locks, cap/crown patches, pointed nape, eye corners, nasal/lip/chin shape and cord-like ear folds remain. These focused portraits do not establish full-body animation quality. V15 is a separate V13-derived animation repair; independent sampled CPU grounding checks pass with importer and contact limits.

entries.title: Daybreak r04 — failed technical baseline
entries.changes: Four-point fabric silhouette and layered pier heads are concrete local gains; lost shaft ornament and shallow underside make the result mixed. This frozen baseline has duplicate fixture anchors and is retained offline for comparison.
entries.remaining: Each affected fixture has 12 canopy-seat and 12 pier-seat nodes instead of four each: hidden LOD anchors leaked into exports. Four fixtures also inherit 20 misplaced floor-adapter anchor positions at the origin, with meter-scale errors; two modules have altered lower-LOD canonical names from Blender decimal suffixing. The 691-check native module-consumer pass does not certify fixture-assembly anchors. R05 repairs are independently checked and published separately in this bundle; this r04 baseline remains failed and unchanged. Canopy underside, receiver hardware, arches, materials and full-kit acceptance remain open.
